title: Darth Vader
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Darth Vader's presence (front) looms over Cloud City as the Millennium Falcon makes its approach. Meanwhile, Luke Skywalker and friends (back) are getting the worst of it in a surprise attack. Both gouache paintings by British illustrator John B. Higgins appeared as covers on Marvel's THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK monthlies in the U.K. (Collection of William Plumb.)
